q: aicoo, draft a PR description for adding dark mode toggle.
reply: Here's a draft PR description for the dark mode toggle feature. I've based it on the manual toggle approach we decided to ship first (v1), with auto-toggle based on system preference deferred to v2.

Adds a manual toggle for users to switch between light and dark mode. This is the first iteration (v1) of the dark mode feature, shipping manual toggle only. Auto-toggle based on system preference will be added in a follow-up (v2).
- Dark mode CSS variables and theme switching logic
- Updated all core UI components to respect dark mode theme

Dark mode was the most requested feature in our Q3 customer survey (80%+ demand). The manual toggle approach allows us to ship quickly while gathering feedback before adding auto-toggle logic. Beta feedback from 35 users showed 87% satisfaction with the core dark mode experience.
- Unit tests for toggle component and preference persistence
- Visual regression tests for all themed components
- Beta group validation (20+ users, positive feedback)
- Additional UX refinements based on v1 feedback
Let me know if you want me to adjust the scope, tone, or add any technical details from Ravi or Yuki.
